svg.text: Round 1, greyscale. Phone 412x915. The check runs on the host service (it already checks hourly and when Nod opens). Paired phones need the check route opened to them. Sample data synthetic.
The menu row opens a small sheet with the version, last check and a Check now button. The answer stays in the sheet.
Updates row shows the host's version.
